# NoteRecord { #timetoalign.alignment.NoteRecord }

```python
alignment.NoteRecord(
    id,
    midi_pitch,
    onset_tick,
    offset_tick,
    velocity,
    channel=0,
    track=0,
)
```

Performance note record for ``.match`` format export.

Each field corresponds to a positional element in the ``note(...)``
Prolog-style term.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type         | Description                                  |
|-------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------|
| id          | [str](`str`) | Performance note identifier (e.g. ``"n0"``). |
| midi_pitch  | [int](`int`) | MIDI pitch number (0–127).                   |
| onset_tick  | [int](`int`) | MIDI onset tick.                             |
| offset_tick | [int](`int`) | MIDI offset tick.                            |
| velocity    | [int](`int`) | MIDI velocity (0–127).                       |
| channel     | [int](`int`) | MIDI channel (default 0).                    |
| track       | [int](`int`) | MIDI track (default 0).                      |
